completeness_assessment.issue: All required documentation elements are present. No completeness issues identified.
completeness_assessment.recommendation: Continue maintaining comprehensive documentation standards for all datasets, fields, and metrics.

accuracy_assessment.issue: Field customer_code has type STRING(255) in glossary but STRING (no length specified) in semantic model.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Align type definitions between glossary and semantic model. Either add explicit length constraints to semantic model STRING types or document that semantic model uses platform-native types without explicit lengths.

accuracy_assessment.issue: Multiple STRING fields (first_name, last_name, email, phone, gender, city, state, postal_code, customer_segment, _source_system) have explicit length constraints STRING(255) in glossary but are defined as STRING without length in semantic model.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Standardize type definitions across both artifacts. Document whether semantic model intentionally abstracts away length constraints or should mirror glossary precision.

accuracy_assessment.issue: Field _loaded_at is defined as TIMESTAMP(29,9) in glossary (with precision and scale) but as TIMESTAMP in semantic model (no precision specified).
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Align timestamp precision definitions. Either add precision/scale to semantic model or document that semantic model uses default platform timestamp types.

accuracy_assessment.issue: All primary key, unique, and not-null constraints from glossary are accurately reflected in semantic model.
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Continue maintaining constraint alignment between glossary and semantic model for data integrity validation.

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics follow similar patterns for counting customers by different dimensions (customer_count_by_segment, active_customer_count_by_segment, customer_count_by_country). These could potentially share a common base query or CTE.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a reusable base customer count query that can be parameterized by dimension and filter criteria to reduce code duplication and improve maintainability.

efficiency_assessment.issue: Three metrics (customer_registrations_by_date, customer_registrations_by_month, customer_registrations_by_year) follow the same pattern with different DATE_TRUNC granularities.
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a parameterized temporal aggregation pattern or template that accepts granularity as a parameter (day/month/year) to reduce redundant metric definitions.
